tasks.goal: Build a no-dependency Node CLI in word-frequency.js that accepts one UTF-8 text-file path and prints a JSON object mapping lowercase words to occurrence counts, ordered by first appearance. Punctuation and blank input must be handled, while missing arguments and unreadable files exit non-zero. Verify representative success and error invocations. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, create package.json and README.md with a 'Verified invocations' section documenting exact observed commands and outputs.
